# okapi: Open Data Kit (ODK)-based Computer-assisted Personal Interview (CAPI) Tools

Data collection using computer-assisted personal interviewing (CAPI)
tools is now the standard approach for conducting surveys and studies. A
wide range of CAPI systems are currently being used. The ability to
interface with these systems helps in the overall data process. This
package provides interface functions to CAPI systems based on the [Open
Data Kit (ODK)](https://getodk.org) technology.

## What does the package do?

Currently, [okapi](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/) provides functions to
interface with [ONA](https://getodk.org) via its
[API](https://api.ona.io/static/docs/index.html). The current set of
functions perform the following tasks:

1.  Authenticate with the respective servers using either an account
    password or an API token;

2.  List resources in the server available to interface with; and,

3.  Get data or resources from the server to
    [R](https://cran.r-project.org).

## Installation

[okapi](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/) is not yet on
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org) but can be installed from the
[RapidSurveys R Universe](https://rapidsurveys.r-universe.dev) with:

``` r
install.packages(
  "okapi", 
  repos = c(
    'https://rapidsurveys.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'
  )
)
```

## Citation

If you use [okapi](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/) in your work, please
cite using the suggested citation provided by a call to the `citation`
function as follows:

``` r

#> 
#>   Ernest Guevarra (2026). _okapi: Open Data Kit (ODK)-based
#>   Computer-assisted Personal Interview (CAPI) Tools_.

#>   <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.206914853>, R package version

```

# Package index

## Description

- [`okapi-package`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/okapi.md)
  [`okapi`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/okapi.md) : Open
  Data Kit (ODK)-based Computer-assisted Personal Interview (CAPI) Tools

## ONA API - Setup

- [`ona_auth_password()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_auth_password.md)
  : Basic authentication to ONA with a username and password
- [`ona_auth_token()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_auth_token.md)
  : Basic authentication to ONA with API authentication token
- [`ona_configure()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_configure.md)
  : Configure HTTP headers

## ONA API - Data

- [`ona_data_get()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_data_get.md)
  : Retrieve specific dataset by form ID from specific user
- [`ona_data_list()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_data_list.md)
  : Retrieve list of datasets available to specific user

## ONA API - Forms

- [`ona_form_delete()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_form_delete.md)
  : Delete published form
- [`ona_form_list()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_form_list.md)
  : List published forms
- [`ona_form_publish()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_form_publish.md)
  : Publish XLSForm

## ONA API - Projects

- [`ona_project_delete()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_project_delete.md)
  : Delete registered project
- [`ona_project_info()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_project_info.md)
  : Get project info
- [`ona_project_list()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_project_list.md)
  : List projects
- [`ona_project_register()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_project_register.md)
  : Register a project
- [`ona_project_share()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_project_share.md)
  : Share projects with user(s)

## ONA API - Organisations

- [`ona_org_delete()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_org_delete.md)
  : Delete registered organisation
- [`ona_org_list()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_org_list.md)
  : List organisations
- [`ona_org_register()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/ona_org_register.md)
  : Register an organisation

## KoBo Toolbox API

- [`kobo_auth_password()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/kobo_auth_password.md)
  : Basic authentication to KoBo Toolbox with a username and password
- [`kobo_auth_token()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/kobo_auth_token.md)
  : Basic authentication to KoBo Toolbox with API authentication token
- [`kobo_get_data()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/kobo_get_data.md)
  : Retrieve specific dataset by form ID from specific user
- [`kobo_list_assets()`](https://rapidsurveys.io/okapi/dev/reference/kobo_list_assets.md)
  : Retrieve list of assets available to specific user
